song_craft: Twenty-nine salutations (29v): paradox-pairs bowed, each namaḥ holding both poles (cool-fire/devourer, Veda-foe/maker, maker/unmaker, bound/free, all-rites/rite-free). Arc: stuff-catalogue (vv1–6) → hidden-master (v7) → round maker/unmaker (v8) → root-tip-Full (v9) → Name-merit (v10) → play amid crowds (v11) → six-opposites (v12) → sport-unmakes (v13) → shore-powers (v14) → mud-lotus (v15) → epithet-pile (v16) → bound-free (v17) → jeering-world (v18) → rite-heart (v19) → whoever-god (v20) → fever-thief (v21) → ever-feast (v22) → TURN: dread power-ring (v23) → held-fast (v24) → nectar-sheath (v25) → I-praise (v26) → canvas-teaching (v27) → our-bowing-road (v28) → SEAL shelter-come (v29).
